Why Muhammad is a messenger

The book reproves him

He stood before his people and recited the words that reproved him and bound him.

The Quran asks him why he forbade himself what God had made lawful. When people ask him to change the recitation, it has him answer that this is not his to change. It says that if he had made up a word in God's name, he would have been seized. He recited all of this aloud, to people watching him closely. Whatever you make of him, he stood under this book, not over it.

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

Quran · At-Tahrim 66:1

﴿وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَاتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۙ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا ٱئْتِ بِقُرْءَانٍ غَيْرِ هَـٰذَآ أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ ۚ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُۥ مِن تِلْقَآئِ نَفْسِىٓ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Bring us a Qur’ān other than this or change it." Say, [O Muḥammad], "It is not for me to change it on my own accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

Quran · Yunus 10:15

﴿وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ٤٤ لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ٤٥ ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ٤٦ فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ٤٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings, We would have seized him by the right hand; Then We would have cut from him the aorta. And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

Quran · Al-Haqqah 69:44-47

You might ask

QuestionCouldn't he have said this to look humble?
AnswerSome critics read it so, as a device. This app calls it a sign, not a proof alone. Weigh it with the rest of his life.Quran · Al-Haqqah 69:44
QuestionDoesn't the Quran also praise him?
AnswerIt does: great character, a fine example. Praise and reproof stand side by side, in a voice that speaks from above him.Quran · Al-Qalam 68:4
QuestionWhy reprove one God has chosen?
AnswerBecause he is human, and the Book says so. The reproof is gentle: one verse opens with pardon, another closes with forgiveness. No one stands above God's word.Quran · At-Tahrim 66:1

He stood under the book, as he asked everyone else to.
